evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Audit the default scope. Two entries in ai/lessons/admin-web.md describe the same route-ownership pitfall from one correction. No other scope mentions it. Do not apply edits yet.
evals.expected_output: A review artifact that proposes consolidating the duplicate scoped lesson without promoting it, reports footprint impact, previews exact text, and stops for approval.
assertions: The candidate remains scoped because one correction is insufficient promotion evidence
The proposal merges duplicate lesson text rather than adding a global commandment
Exact before and after text plus destination path are shown
No memory file is edited before explicit approval

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Three independent project lesson files say agents must not absorb unrelated dirty working-tree changes. ai/CLAUDE.md already says changes should touch only what is necessary. Audit only; do not edit.
evals.expected_output: A proposal that recognizes the existing commandment, consolidates evidence without adding a near-duplicate, and suggests a surgical revision only if the existing wording fails to cover the behavior.
assertions: The existing higher-precedence rule is identified
A duplicate global commandment is rejected
Any proposed revision uses one concise verifiable sentence
The report compares loaded footprint before and after and waits for approval

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory I explicitly want this treated as a durable cross-project rule: preview the exact external mutation and get my approval before applying it. Check for conflicts and prepare the proposal only.
evals.expected_output: A conservative promotion proposal, if novel, with explicit durable-human evidence, exact destination and wording, conflict analysis, footprint delta, and no applied edit.
assertions: Explicit human durability satisfies the evidence gate but all other gates are still evaluated
The candidate is rejected or revised if an equivalent approval rule already exists
Any proposed commandment is one observable sentence ideally under 30 words
No edit occurs before a separate approval turn

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Review these candidates: a temporary branch name, yesterday's meeting status, an API token, a merchant email, and a verified recurring testing pitfall supported by two postmortems.
evals.expected_output: A classified proposal that rejects transient and sensitive entries, evaluates the testing pitfall for its proper scope, and discloses sensitive findings without reproducing their values.
assertions: The branch and meeting status are removed or excluded as transient
The API token and merchant email are never stored or echoed
The recurring pitfall is promoted only if every gate passes at the chosen scope
The report stops for approval

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Several lessons repeat a twelve-step production deployment and rollback sequence. One lesson suggests it may already exist in skills/deploy/SKILL.md. Prepare the memory-only consolidation approach without editing.
evals.expected_output: A proposal that keeps or defers the procedure outside always-loaded memory without reading, comparing, proposing changes to, or modifying any skill file.
assertions: The twelve-step procedure is not promoted verbatim
No skill file or skill eval is read or compared
No skill change is proposed; separate explicit work is required
The memory-only context-cost impact is reported and exact edits await approval

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Apply approved proposal IDs 1 and 3. One target file changed after the preview was approved.
evals.expected_output: The operation stops on drift, preserves all files, and presents a refreshed proposal rather than applying stale exact edits.
assertions: Every target is re-read before editing
Detected drift blocks all stale operations
No unrelated or partially approved edit is applied
The human receives an updated exact proposal

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory A Shopify lesson says CI failed, the known translation guard cannot explain it, the root cause is still unknown, and the Buildkite log has not been reviewed. Make it timeless and concise.
evals.expected_output: A clarification or keep proposal that preserves the unknown root cause and required next evidence instead of replacing them with a confident timeless conclusion.
assertions: Unknown or unverified status is treated as useful information
The Buildkite log remains the next evidence needed
No cause is invented and the candidate is not promoted as settled
Any edit remains behind explicit approval

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Promote this explicit durable preference: lead with the decision; use short paragraphs for explanation, bullets for distinct points, numbered lists for steps, tables for comparisons, and headings for major topics; prefer lay terms and plainly explain necessary technical terms; preserve uncertainty.
evals.expected_output: A compact commandment block with separate actionable prose rules rather than a vague one-line instruction to format for the task.
assertions: The proposal leads with the point and names purpose-fit formats
Lay vocabulary and plain explanations for necessary technical terms remain explicit
Uncertainty remains explicit
A 2–4 bullet block is allowed because compressing the independent actions would reduce specificity

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory One lesson says Context should use 1–3 bullets. Another section says Context should default to one paragraph and use bullets only for more than three points. Their headings and wording differ.
evals.expected_output: A semantic conflict finding that compares the shared trigger and incompatible actions, then preserves both until rationale or human direction resolves them.
assertions: The conflict is found despite different headings and vocabulary
Trigger, action, scope, and boundaries are compared
The report does not claim conflict-free status based only on keyword searches
No winner is chosen without sufficient rationale or human direction

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Three lessons show wrong-repository harm before editing, committing, and pushing. The proposed commandment begins: 'Before committing or pushing, verify the repository and worktree.'
evals.expected_output: A coverage failure that revises the rule to include editing because every claimed prevented failure must map to an exact clause.
assertions: The evidence-to-rule coverage map identifies editing as uncovered
The revised trigger includes editing, committing, and pushing
The report does not claim protection against failures the wording cannot prevent
The revised rule is still concise and observable

evals.prompt: /skill:refine-memory Prepare a full audit with five proposed operations and several hundred lines of exact patches. The human needs to decide what to approve.
evals.expected_output: A report that begins with a short verdict, decision table, risks, footprint, and approval choices before detailed evidence and patch appendices.
assertions: Human review appears before scope methodology and exact patches
The opening uses lay terms and makes approval choices obvious
Risks and unresolved questions are visible before the appendix
Detailed evidence remains available without burying the outcome
